_artifact_note: Extract of a PubMed efetch XML response (accessed 2026-08-10), reduced to the fields that bear on the correction/retraction question: for each cited PMID, every CommentsCorrections link and its RefType, plus the publication types. Titles and abstracts are dropped under this packet's bibliographic-metadata-only retention rule. Complete with respect to records - all seven requested PMIDs are present.
_why: article_types alone cannot detect a correction or retraction published as a SEPARATE PubMed record: the original stays typed 'Journal Article' and only the linked notice carries the type. PubMed is the sole notice check for PMID:41673870, so relying on article_types there left a real hole in the completeness claim. This query closes it by reading the CommentsCorrections links directly.
conclusion: No cited paper carries any CommentsCorrections link at all, so none carries an erratum, retraction, correction, republication or expression-of-concern link. Together with the Scite editorialNotices check on six of them and the article_types check on all seven, the correction/retraction status is negative on every leg available.
